description: Root provenance manifest. setup.ps1 holds a single constant, the SHA-256 digest of this file, and derives every other address, digest, version, and ordered name from the sources listed here. Entries with a null url are authored in this repository; entries with a url are commit-pinned upstream sources whose published bytes must hash to the recorded digest.

sources.role: Ordered 96-name lean assembly payload. Architecture-neutral IL, used for every target.
Launcher icon, 1024x1024 PNG. Packaged as res/mipmap/ic_launcher.png behind the emitted resources.arsc.

TRAINING WHEELS, to be removed. Produced by MSBuild from the reference csproj facade against the same pinned packs, so it is version-matched to the shipped runtime and reproducible locally, but it is still not emitted by setup.ps1. The replacement path is known and requires no build tool: Microsoft.Android.Sdk ships tools/java_runtime_clr.dex, 8728 bytes, already dexed, holding mono.android.Runtime, MonoPackageManager, GCUserPeer and IGCUserPeer. That plus an emitted mono.MonoRuntimeProvider and the peers setup.ps1 already emits replaces this 423KB artifact entirely.
Test fixture. The Xamarin-mode binary AndroidManifest.xml proven on hardware; -ValidateManifest requires the emitter to reproduce it byte for byte. Re-pin only as a deliberate manifest change.

Upstream reference only. arm::getDefaultFloatABI returns SoftFP for the Android environment, the calling convention emitted ARM32 code follows and the reason e_flags carries EF_ARM_ABI_FLOAT_SOFT with EF_ARM_EABI_VER5.

Upstream reference only. bionic at android-14.0.0_r1. ElfReader::VerifyElfHeader defines what the Android loader rejects: magic, class, byte order, e_type, e_version, e_machine, e_shentsize, e_shstrndx. It never reads e_flags.
Android liblog API at android-14.0.0_r1. The android_LogPriority enum and __android_log_write, which the emitted native host calls.
Android NativeActivity API at android-14.0.0_r1. ANativeActivity_onCreate is the entry point the framework NativeActivity calls in the library named by android.app.lib_name.
CoreCLR hosting API at v11.0.0-rc.1.26425.128: coreclr_initialize and coreclr_create_delegate, which the emitted native host calls.
CoreCLR host contract at v11.0.0-rc.1.26425.128. external_assembly_probe lets a host serve assemblies from memory it owns, such as the mapped store.
ELF dynamic tag values, included by ELF.h rather than defined in it.
